title: Juicy Thai Lentils Bao
description: A light, post-workout Thai dish featuring brown lentils, perfect for fitness enthusiasts. This recipe is anti-inflammatory-friendly and easy to make.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the brown lentils, tomato paste, fish-free sauce, and Thai red curry paste, stir until the lentils are well coated with the spice mixture.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
While the lentils are cooking, warm the bao buns by steaming them in a steamer basket for 5 minutes.
Once the lentils are cooked, fluff them with a fork and season with salt to taste.
Assemble the bao by spooning the lentils into the warmed buns, and garnishing with chopped fresh cilantro.
Repeat the process with the remaining lentil mixture and buns.
Store any leftover bao in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
